H1.rule: at n = 25, proper-score selection (B) has lower mean regret than correlation selection (A) in >= 3 of 5 sets and the paired 95% interval excludes 0 in >= 2 of those sets

H2.rule: at n = 200 the absolute difference in mean regret between A and B is below 0.005 skill points in all 5 sets

H3.rule: smallest n on the grid at which |A minus B| < 0.005 in every set
